decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch that extends the firm’s established automation offer in a growing business with ongoing investment, management is likely to keep backing it and view any early uncertainty as temporary.

This product also builds on the core portfolio and recent development effort, so a German machinery firm with broad solutions and service capabilities would be inclined to retain it rather than reverse course quickly.

Although more distant from the legacy offer, it was publicly framed as a flagship strategic direction and already received visible recognition, which strongly reinforces commitment to keep it on the market.
